---
applyTo: "**/*.md"
---

# Docs guidance

- Never include real secrets, tokens, phone numbers, or private URLs.
- Prefer private-by-default guidance for authentication and service exposure.
- If documenting a new feature or behavior change, ensure it matches the relevant `.plan/` doc(s); if the plan is missing, note the gap and ask to update the plan first.
- When showing example secret values, make them clearly fake (e.g., `KEY_REDACTED`, `+15555550123`).
